items.quote: we believe there is a no need for APS to enter in the solar cell business rather than that we better enter or invest our hard-earned money and investors' invested money in the business where we can manage our fi nancial discipline and future growth

So, the grid instability is not in solar pump business, not in ground -mounting not in residential rooftop business or C&I rooftop business. items.quote: The margin expansion achieved during the year was supported by operating leverage, an improved product mix, and a continued focus on execution.

items.statement: Medical segment targeted at 5% of FY27 revenue
items.quote: We are targeting on FY27, we are targeting about 5% of our revenue to come from the medical side.

items.statement: Exports at ~50% of FY26 revenue, expected to continue
items.quote: I think this was one of the good years where we saw a large portion of our, a significant portion almost crossing 50% of our revenue coming from exports. So we see exports being at around 50% of our revenue.

items.statement: Export geographies: Europe larger than US
items.quote: I would say Europe is a little larger when compared to US.

items.statement: JV with Israeli defense prime for manufacturing in India
items.quote: One is a joint venture agreement that we have signed with an Israeli defense prime. This is primarily for manufacturing of defense systems in India.

items.statement: US subsidiary incorporated for two shortlisted programs
items.quote: We've incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary in the US because we've had two programs that we have been shortlisted for manufacturing in the US and we are trying to look at US opportunities as well.

items.statement: Completed INR150 crore preferential equity raise
items.quote: Another important milestone was the successful completion of our INR150 crore s preferential equity raise.

items.statement: 10-15% of supplies from Israel, supply chains stabilized
items.quote: So, we have a dependency on Israel, about 10% to 15% of our supplies come from Israel. We have some critical components that are coming towards some critical programs out of Israel. Supply chains were disrupted briefly during the geopolitical s ituation, but now things have smoothened out, and we have better logistics channels to India.

items.statement: Semiconductor supply chain challenges easing in 3-4 months
items.quote: we see that the semiconductor supply chain is going to improve, and since we are fairly dependent only on the semiconductor supply chain, we see that over the next three to four months, we should see some improvement on the supply chain side as well.

items.statement: Nadcap accreditation achieved for electronic and PCB assemblies
items.quote: One of the significant milestones for us was the successful achievement of Nadcap accreditation for electronic and PCB assemblies.

items.statement: Expanding capabilities to system integration and Class 3 manufacturing
items.quote: Over time, we have steadily expanded our capabilities to include cable harness, electro-mechanical assemblies, testing, subsystem integration, and system-level manufacturing.

items.statement: Added new customers in aerospace, industrial, medical sectors
items.quote: During this year, we also continued to expand our customer base and added several new customer relationships across aerospace, industrial, and medical sectors.

items.statement: FY26 revenue INR518 crores, EBITDA INR64.77 crores, PAT INR30.87 crores
items.quote: For the full year, we reported a revenue of INR518 crores. EBITDA for the year stood at INR64.77 crores with an EBITDA margin improving to 12.5%. Profit after tax stood for the year at INR30.8 7 crores.

items.statement: Geopolitical environment dynamic, creating short-term disruptions
items.quote: The global geopolitical environment remains dynamic, with ongoing conflicts, trade realignments, increasing focus on national security, continuing to influence supply chains and investment decisions across the industry.

items.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue trending towards 1,377 crores, 52% growth on retained business base
items.quote: Consolidated FY27 revenue is trending towards 1,377 crores (52% growth on the retained business base).

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin target 150-200 bps improvement year-on-year from core verticals average of 20%+
items.quote: What remains are the core verticals where the average EBITDA is already at 20% plus, and we aim for a 150 to 200 bps improvement year-on-year.

items.statement: FY30 revenue target 9,000 crores with 25%+ EBITDA margin, PAT target maintained
items.quote: We are sticking to the 9,000-crore target; this is a foundational year.

items.statement: FY27 visibility includes 927 crores orders under execution, 285 crores assured forecast from design wins, 165 crores acquisition-linked visibility
items.quote: This includes 927 crores in orders currently under execution (including the 142 crores from Q4), 285 crores in assured forecast visibility from design wins, and 165 crores of acquisition-linked visibility.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 150 bps to 15.3%, core domains aerospace 17.3%, defense 22.9%, ESAI 26.1%
items.quote: EBITDA was at 178 crores (24.6% growth year-on-year) with margins at 15.3%, which is 150 bps more than last year.

items.statement: Normalized EBITDA margins around 17-18% adjusting for Q4 deferment, core verticals average 20%+ EBITDA
items.quote: The non-core verticals were margin-dilutive. What remains are the core verticals where the average EBITDA is already at 20% plus

items.statement: Total investment plan 2,100-2,250 crores: DAC 1,200 crores, MAC 300 crores, DAL 120 crores, acquisitions ~600 crores, self-funded through restructuring
items.quote: DAC is 1,200 crores, MAC is 300 crores, and DAL is 120 crores (of which 100 crores is already spent). Acquisitions will cost roughly 600 crores. The total investment plan is between 2,100 to 2,250 crores

items.statement: Devanahalli campuses and Missile Atmanirbhar Complex (MAC) in Hyderabad operational through FY27, aerospace manufacturing acquisition to jumpstart high-value manufacturing in Q3 FY27
items.quote: Our Devanahalli campuses and our Missile Atmanirbhar Complex (MAC) in Hyderabad will become operational through FY27, and we have initiated expansion beyond them.

items.statement: Q4 revenue deferment of 142 crores due to supply chain disruptions, not demand erosion; orders intact, revenue moved to FY27 visibility across Q1-Q2
items.quote: The underlying contract values remain intact, and customer relationships remain unaffected. The revenue has moved into FY27 visibility, with recognition expected across Q1 and Q2

items.statement: Closing receivables 411 crores, DSO 130 days; collected 154.5 crores since March bringing DSO to 81 days; negative operating cash flow driven by 100 crores land systems WIP
items.quote: Closing receivables were 411 crores with a DSO of 130 days. Since March, we have collected 154.5 crores, bringing the DSO down to 81 days.

items.statement: Gross borrowings increased 87 crores to 276 crores for project-specific working capital for land systems; retires as invoices issued in H1 FY27
items.quote: Gross borrowings increased by 87 crores to 276 crores for project-speciﬁc working capital for land systems; this retires as invoices are issued.

items.statement: Phase 1 divestment to Akkodis for USD $30.63 million cash pre-tax, closing Q2 FY27; expected extraordinary gain ~175 crores (41 rupees per share EPS)
items.quote: on May 26th, 2026, AXISCADES signed deﬁnitive agreements to divest the heavy engineering, energy, and automotive practice to 5 Akkodis for USD $30.63 million in cash pre

items.statement: Phase 2 disinvestment coming soon to fund DAC, DAL, MAC and acquisitions; planning to acquire four companies
items.quote: Phase 2 of the disinvestment is coming very soon and will fund us totally for DAC, DAL, MAC, and our acquisitions. We are planning to acquire four companies once this is through.

items.statement: Advanced stages of finalizing aerospace manufacturing acquisition to jumpstart high-value manufacturing in Q3 FY27; evaluating two acquisitions for Xida Inc.
items.quote: We are also in advanced stages of ﬁnalizing an aerospace manufacturing acquisition that will jumpstart high-value manufacturing activities in Q3 of FY27.

items.statement: Core domains aerospace, defense, ESAI generated 904 crores (78% of revenue): aerospace 388 crores (21% growth), defense 379 crores (25% growth), ESAI 136 crores (9% growth)
items.quote: Regarding domain mix, the core domains of aerospace, defense, and ESAI generated 904 crores in revenue (78% of consolidated revenue)

items.statement: Created Xida Inc., US-led Silicon Valley deep tech AI subsidiary; existing ESAI business and AI team moving into Xida with two acquisitions evaluated
items.quote: We have initiated the creation of Xida Inc. Xida Inc. is an American-led, Silicon Valley-headquartered deep tech and AI company.

items.statement: Space division established focusing on space bus, space payloads, synthetic aperture radar; Space Situational Awareness initiative with Aldoria underway
items.quote: We have established a Space Division. Our Space Situational Awareness initiative with Aldoria is underway, and we are evaluating strategic partnerships for space-related manufacturing

items.statement: Strongest year for building relationships with global OEMs; powerful pipeline carried into FY27; $3.5 million order from Qualcomm for ESAI
items.quote: FY26 was our strongest year yet for building relationships with global OEMs, and we carry a powerful pipeline into FY27.

items.statement: Government policy shifts towards Make in India required proposal changes; all subject to government approval
items.quote: OEM relationships are strong, although government policy shifts towards "Make in India" have required us to change our proposals. Everything is subject to government approval

items.statement: 3.8 million shares reserved for ESOPs; plan to align provisioning with 175 crore extraordinary income from divestment; award by Q2 after headcount reduction to ~1,200
items.quote: We have 3.8 million shares kept for ESOPs. We plan to align the provisioning with the 175-crore extraordinary income from the divestment. By Q2, we should be able to award the entire pool

items.statement: Supply chain disruptions caused Q4 revenue deferment: defense manufacturing critical input constraint, monopolistic hardware supplier redirected to war programs, divestment transition impact
items.quote: The broader learning is clear: as AXISCADES moves from an engineering-led model to manufacturing-linked execution, we need stronger supply chain buffers, acceptance slot planning, and program management discipline.

items.statement: Restructuring will reduce headcount to roughly 1,200 people by Q2 FY27
items.quote: By Q2, we should be able to award the entire pool as the restructuring will reduce our headcount to roughly 1,200 people.

items.statement: FY26 revenue 1,159 crores (12.4% growth), EBITDA 178 crores (24.6% growth), normalized PAT 83 crores (27.6% growth), reported PAT 72 crores (4.3% degrowth)
items.quote: Revenue was at 1,159 crores (12.4% growth year-on-year), and EBITDA was at 178 crores (24.6% growth year-on-year) with margins at 15.3%

items.statement: Management expects FY27 to follow the same growth trajectory as the past three years with additional profits reinvested to build more media inventory.
items.quote: Sir, which will be on the same growth trajectory, sir. With additional profits coming in, this money will be pulled up to build up more media and it will be on similar trajectory, sir.

items.statement: Management targets exclusive media revenue share to reach 50% in the next three years, up from 32% in FY26.
items.quote: So next three years the target is to achieve 50% equal contribution for exclusive as well as the trade media.

items.statement: Exclusive media commands roughly 2x the margin of traded media due to the absence of an intermediary margin split.
items.quote: See, it's -- to just quantify with the numbers because if we trade a media, there's a difference of at least X and 2X.

items.statement: Management considers year-on-year EBITDA margin improvement a fair assumption as exclusive media share grows.
items.quote: For sure. That's a fair assumption.

items.statement: Exclusive media contributed INR60 crores (32% of revenue) in FY26, up from 19% in FY25.
items.quote: So Disha, the last year the exclusive media contributed to 19% of the revenue. This year it has gone up to 32%. So around INR60 crores of revenue from operations has come to -- is contributed by exclusive media.

items.statement: Repeat business from regular clients accounts for 25-30% of total revenue; the company does not maintain a traditional order book.
items.quote: Sir, long-term -- see we don't have order books in this business. We have regular clients who do repeat business with us. So if you are asking about the repeat business, repeat business would be about 25% to 30% of repeat business with our clients of the total revenue.

items.statement: Additional investment of INR3-4 crores planned over the next 2-3 years to build advertising infrastructure on ~350 EV charging stations.
items.quote: See this is the only investment which is there. So there would be additional investment of about INR3 crores to INR4 crores which will go in next 2 years to 3 years to build up the charging systems because there are about 350 charging stations we will be advertising.

items.statement: Current inventory utilization is 50-55%; target is to reach 50-55% utilization next year on existing inventory while adding new inventory.
items.quote: So the utilization should go up to 50%, 55% next year.

items.statement: The company operates across 25 cities with a footprint of ~10 lakh cabs available for advertising, sourced from driver-cum-owners rather than fleet vendors.
items.quote: It's a footprint that we have approximately 10 lakh cabs which are available across India and where we can advertise.

items.statement: In exclusive monopoly markets (e.g., Banaras), the company charges premium rates to clients as the sole media owner.
items.quote: And since we are working in a monopolistic market, if I talk about like a town like Banaras where we have exclusivity, and there we can charge premium to the clients because we are the only media owners.

items.statement: Strategic acquisitions: ~19% stake in Kolkata Call Taxi (supply model for campaign-owned cars) and 50% stake in CharjKaro (EV charging + advertising rights); 10-year concession from Nagar Nigam Rishikesh for EV charging infrastructure and a
items.quote: We have acquired approximately 19% stake in Kolkata Call Taxi, strengthening our presence with the urban mobility ecosystem which can change the future of the infrastructure in India. We have also acquired 50% stake in CharjKaro Greentech Mobility Limited, which will help us providing a rapidly growing EV charging stations under PM E-Drive and other government initiatives and get associated advert

items.statement: Government campaigns (e.g., Viksit Bharat, Dehradun Expressway launch, tourism) and occasional political party consulting contribute to revenue; event-driven campaigns (IPL, Kumbh, elections) contribute 10-20% of revenue depending on the ye
items.quote: So every year there is one or the other campaign which contributes to the top line as well as bottom line. And since they are very time-bound, like IPL is time-bound, Kumbh is time-bound, so it's a very opex and capex-heavy business which is there at that time. So they do contribute about 10 to 20% of the revenue depending on the kind of event which is there.

items.statement: Working capital cycle improved from ~150 days three years ago to 110-120 days currently; target is 100 days via CRM and reconciliation tools. Receivables typically collected in 90-120 days.
items.quote: For us also last three years back the working capital cycle was around 150 days. Now we have moved to around 110 to 120 days. Going forward our target is to achieve 100 days by implementing this CRM, all the reconciliation tools and all these tools.

items.statement: Operating cash flows were negative in FY26 due to ~INR20 crores of advances paid for exclusive media tenders/concessions; expected to normalize as collections from those assets ramp up.
items.quote: So, this year around INR20 crores of advance we have paid to these suppliers. So that is why the cash flows are operating are negative. But gradually when we move to, we get the collections from the from the clients on this exclusive media. So, this is one-time cycle, this will be normalized.

items.statement: Company is debt-free and cash-rich, providing flexibility for growth investments.
items.quote: Similar growth with the profitability this year, that money to be added on, similar growth, we are a cash-rich company, debt-free company.

items.statement: FY26 revenue grew 33.98% YoY to INR186.7 crores; EBITDA grew 59.2% to INR33.56 crores with margin expansion of 285 bps to 17.98%; Net profit grew 64.98% to INR29.4 crores with margin of 15.28%.
items.quote: For FY26, our revenue from operations has increased by 33.98% year-on-year basis to INR186.7 crores compared to INR139.3 crores in FY25. EBITDA also grew by 59.2% to INR33.56 crores from INR21.1 crores in the previous year. EBITDA margin has also expanded by 285 basis points to 17.98%.

items.statement: H2 FY26 revenue grew 43.72% YoY to INR108.8 crores; EBITDA grew 86.06% to INR20.02 crores with margin expansion of 420 bps to 18.41%; Net profit grew 94.5% to INR18.5 crores with margin of 16.33%.
items.quote: During H2 FY26, revenue has gone up by 43.72% year-on-year basis to INR108.8 crores. EBITDA rose by whopping 86.06% to INR20.02 crores, while EBITDA margin improved significantly by 420 basis points to 18.41%.

items.statement: Aspires to match Signpost India (mainboard listed) in scale and profitability over the next 3-5 years; currently operates at a lower PE multiple (~under 10 vs peers at 30-40).
items.quote: Sir, Signpost is one of the leading players in the market and they are doing phenomenally well. So that is something which as a SME would really like to achieve in that sense. They are a mainboard listed company. So that is a peer that we are looking up to.

items.statement: AI-driven go-to-market (GTM) strategies and CRM automation deployed to identify client budgets, optimize campaign planning, and track sales processes.
items.quote: We've also developed AI GTM strategies which are go-to-market strategy which is AI-driven also, to see the sense that, which clients are spending and which clients are going to spend more in advertising and require more options like that.

items.statement: EV charging advertising opportunities supported by PM E-Drive and other government initiatives; 10-year concession from Nagar Nigam Rishikesh secured.
items.quote: We have also acquired 50% stake in CharjKaro Greentech Mobility Limited, which will help us providing a rapidly growing EV charging stations under PM E-Drive and other government initiatives and get associated advertising opportunities on all these EV charging stations. In addition, we have secured 10 years build-operate model on concession from Nagar Nigam Rishikesh for EV charging infrastructure

items.statement: Long-term vision: become the largest transit media concessionaire in India and expand to Southeast Asia, covering the full daily transit journey of a common man across bus, train, taxi, metro, airport, and airplane.
items.quote: To be the largest transit media concessioner of the country today and probably expand to Southeast Asia, other countries as well. That's the whole vision. And because most of the times people are spending time either at home or on the move. So, and at home also they are usually on mobile which is digital and on the move. So, we are just targeting when people are on the move, whether it is bus, tra

items.statement: Management declined to provide FY27 revenue or margin targets
items.quote: Management: We would restrain ourselves from giving any number at this stage.

items.statement: Strong demand for acoustic and noise control products driven by HSE compliance and awareness
items.quote: With increasing awareness across all segments, combined with stringent domestic guidelines and international standards, the business is poised for strong, sustained growth.

items.statement: Expanded facility partially commissioned; full operationalization expected within FY27
items.quote: We expect the facility to become fully operational and fully utilized within the current financial year, that is for sure.

items.statement: Achieved CBRI certification for fire-rated doors enabling high-volume orders in high-rise and commercial segments
items.quote: We have achieved a CBRI certification, that is from the Central Building Research Institute, which is a part of IIT Roorkee, for our fire-rated doors which we are manufacturing.

items.statement: Signed MOU with CSIR-NPL for solar noise barriers combining sound mitigation with power generation
items.quote: We have signed an MOU with CSIR-NPL New Delhi for collaborative development of solar noise barriers.

items.statement: Launched blast-resistant doors with strong demand from defense and sensitive sectors; exported to Bhutan and executed projects for BPCL, Pune, Horiba Hyderabad
items.quote: Envirotech has successfully launched and developed blast-resistant doors. The blast-resistant doors are witnessing strong demand for protecting sensitive storage and critical facilities.

items.statement: Served major data center clients including Equinix Mumbai, L&T, AdaniConneX Noida, ST Telemedia Bangalore, NPCI Hyderabad
items.quote: We have served several prestigious clients which includes Equinix data center at Mumbai, we have done some projects for L&T, we have done for AdaniConneX at Noida, we have done work for ST Telemedia at Bangalore, NPCI Hyderabad.

items.statement: Executed semiconductor projects for Tata Projects Micron facility and Tata Semiconductor Assembly
items.quote: We have executed few projects for Tata Projects for Micron semiconductor facility and TSAT, that is Tata Semiconductor Assembly and

items.statement: PAT declined to INR12.11 cr from INR14.06 cr due to absence of one-time property sale income; operational PAT rose from INR9.41 cr to INR11.29 cr
items.quote: Our profit after tax, Profit after tax stood at INR12.11 crores in financial year 2025-2026 compared to INR14.06 crores in the previous year, primarily due to absence of the one-time income from property sale.

items.statement: Raw material price increases from Iran-US conflict slightly impacted margins; mitigation measures implemented
items.quote: The sudden impact also increased price of the raw material, which slightly impacted our margins. However, we have since implemented mitigation measures.

items.statement: Revenue from operations grew 20.95% YoY to INR57.58 cr from INR47.61 cr
items.quote: Revenue from operation grew from INR47.61 crores in financial year 2024 -25 to INR57.58 crores in financial year '25-26, reflecting a healthy Y-O-Y growth of 20.95%.

items.statement: Order book consistently at INR25-30 cr range; management acknowledges not cracking big orders yet but high-volume inquiries at advanced stage
items.quote: We are in conversation with the high volume of orders as of now. But sometime you are right that, very high-volume orders have not been achieved, whereas they are at the pipeline.

items.statement: Iran-US conflict caused project delays and raw material supply shortages impacting H2 FY26 revenue recognition
items.quote: Our company being dependent on infrastructure development, capex has significant revenue coming in the second half of the year, which was impacted by the Iran-US conflict, causing delay and hold in some of our customer sites.

items.statement: Revenue guidance for FY27 is INR1,500-1,700 crores
items.quote: Now based on the existing order book and ongoing bid participation, we are expecting the revenue in the range of INR1500 crores to INR1700 crores in the coming financial year.

items.statement: EBITDA margin target 12-14% for solar modules and BESS EPC
items.quote: Our minimum target for EBITDA will be to try and achieve 12% to 14%.

items.statement: PAT margin target 8-9% for FY27 and FY28
items.quote: We feel our PAT margin will improve to 8% to 9%, that a difference of 1% can occur, 1 to 2%. As compared to the previous year.

items.statement: Current order book approximately INR2,200 crores
items.quote: Currently, we have an order book of approximately INR2,200 crores, which provides strong revenue visibility for the coming period.

items.statement: Actively participating in tenders worth over INR2,500 crores
items.quote: In addition, we are actively participating in the tenders worth more than INR2,500 crores, including the major EPC opportunity.

items.statement: Received 1 GWh BESS order from NTPC REL worth INR1,500 crores
items.quote: We are pleased to share that the company has received the significant order associated with approximately 1 gigawatt hour capacity from NTPC REL.

items.statement: Module capacity expansion planned in phases, decision soon
items.quote: We are coming in phases only. Yes, so we are coming very soon because we are sure that we are getting more new orders for modules. So, I mean, you will get new news too in a few days.

items.statement: Solar cell manufacturing capex ~INR300 crores for 1 GW with Chinese tech support
items.quote: If we now, brother, order a line from some company, then max to max INR300 crores. So it's like this, brother, so many line people are sitting idle there in China.

items.statement: Lithium cell manufacturing capex INR750-800 crores
items.quote: INR750 to INR800 crores investment will be approx.

items.statement: Module capacity utilization 76% in FY26, targeting 85% in FY27
items.quote: Right now, our, we did 76% capacity on that 1.1-gigawatt line's production in the current year. I mean in FY '26.

items.statement: Planning 1 GW solar cell manufacturing if DCR orders materialize
items.quote: When we come first, we will come with 1 gigawatt only.

items.statement: Lithium cell manufacturing planned with Chinese technology partnership
items.quote: We are sending our 12 to 15 good IIT boys to them for technology sharing and the Chinese are supporting us. So now we are moving forward.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin ~10.6% (INR113.58 cr on INR1,067 cr revenue)
items.quote: EBITDA for FY26 increased by 122% to INR113.58 crores as compared to the INR51.16 crores in FY25.

items.statement: BESS EPC EBITDA margin 13-14%
items.quote: My EBITDA margin there will be roughly around 13% to 14% maximum.

items.statement: No price escalation clauses in current contracts
items.quote: There isn't. Sorry, not standard currently, no.

items.statement: Margins impacted by forex, aluminium, copper, silver price volatility
items.quote: While margins during the year were impacted due to the global geopolitical situation, foreign exchange fluctuations, and rising raw material prices such as aluminium, copper, silver, and other metals.

items.statement: Inventory cycle 75 days due to 95% imported materials; advances for glass, cells, frames
items.quote: For the orders I am taking now, given the current market situation. For example, the Sterling & Wilson project of almost 305 megawatt, if I have to start production, I need to provide advances to source materials from China, as more than 95% of our material is imported.

items.statement: Trade receivables collection 10-15 days via LC discounting after billing
items.quote: From billing to payment. If holidays occur or any other timeline, I mean any discrepancy occurs, then it increases by two-four more days sir. So, this is a 10-15 days' process.

items.statement: Total debt ~INR43 crores (INR32 cr working capital + INR10 cr term loan) for INR1,000 cr revenue
items.quote: For a INR1000 crores business, our total working capital and other debt is around INR32 crore, and our term loan is roughly INR10 crore, so it is only about INR43 crores in total.

items.statement: Will increase bank borrowing for working capital; fundraise planned at higher valuation later
items.quote: We are taking even more loans from the bank now. Because all projects have to be completed in one year, turnover has to be finished too, so fund requirement will definitely remain.

items.statement: Fundraise planned but not immediate; will time at good valuation
items.quote: If this, company's fundraise is done as per the company's valuation, then currently will do it after some time but won't do it now. Yes, there is time now.

items.statement: FY26: >70% revenue from manufacturing (lower margin); targeting higher EPC/BESS share
items.quote: In FY26, more than 70% of our business during the year was generated from the manufacturing segment, where the margin was comparatively lower. However, this segment provides the scale, long-term sustainability, and stronger market presence.

items.statement: FY27 revenue mix: 60% modules, 40% BESS and EPC
items.quote: In terms of turnover, it will be higher from modules and EPC. For the full year, 60% of turnover will come from modules and 40% from BESS and EPC.

items.statement: Key clients: NTPC, SJVN, Power Grid, Indian Oil, Sterling & Wilson, UPL
items.quote: We currently have a strong business presence with organizations like NTPC, SJVN, Power Grid Corporation of India, and Indian Oil. In the private sector, we are working with esteemed clients like Sterling & Wilson and UPL.

items.statement: Focusing on non-DCR tenders (2 GW bid) due to better quality and availability vs DCR cells
items.quote: We have also participated in non-DCR tenders for about 2,000 megawatt. We will finalize the order book for the next 1.5 year accordingly

items.statement: DCR cell requirement from June; DCR cells lower efficiency (585W modules)
items.quote: Currently, the cells being manufactured in India for DCR requirements have lower efficiency; for instance, DCR cells are only producing 585 gigawatt modules.

items.statement: Bid pipeline: INR3,000 cr module tenders, INR1,500 cr BESS tenders; expect INR1,000-1,500 cr wins
items.quote: We have participated in INR2000 crores worth of module tenders and are participating in another INR1000 crores. So, between DCR and non-DCR, we have bid for INR3000 crores in modules. In BESS, we have participated in tenders, worth around INR1500 crores. We expect to secure orders worth about INR1000 crores to INR1500 crores from these.

items.statement: Sending 12-15 IIT engineers to China for lithium cell technology transfer
items.quote: We are sending our 12 to 15 good IIT boys to them for technology sharing and the Chinese are supporting us.

items.statement: Revenue guidance of INR200 crores for FY27, INR250 crores for FY28, INR300 crores for FY29; operating margin target ~25% for FY27
items.quote: As required to provide projections, we are pleased to give you our estimated guidance of INR200 crores in financial year '26-'27, INR250 crores in '27-'28, and INR300 crores in financial year '28-'29. Our operating margin for financial year '25-'26 is approximately 25%. In spite of high depreciation and geopolitical situation, we will do our best to perform at the same level.

items.statement: Strong structural demand from FMCG growth, premiumization, urban and rural consumption; industry growing faster than company scale
items.quote: The fragrance and flavor industry continues to witness strong structural demand, supported by rising consumption from FMCG categories, evolving consumer preferences, increasing product differentiation, and growing demand for superior sensory experiences, continue to create long-term growth opportunities for organized and innovation-driven players.

items.statement: Export share 6% of FY26 revenue (INR9.5 crores), up from INR8 crores in FY25; volumes up 20-25%; domestic focus caused percentage decline
items.quote: In '24, '25, our exports were about approximately INR8 crores. However, in '25, '26, the exports have reached to about INR9.5 crores approximately. So there's increase. Yes. And even in terms of volumes, there's been an increase of about 20%, 25%.

items.statement: Cash conversion cycle improved from 109 to 35 days over three years via better inventory, receivables, payables management and quality customer base
items.quote: It is not one answer to this, it's the overall combination of we bringing in expertise, we bringing in how we manage the show on inventories, on our payment receivables, how safely, which kind of client sets you're working with, and how well we're keeping our payments safe as well. So yes, it has definitely significantly improved across and payable days have also significantly reduced.

items.statement: Geopolitical raw material inflation exists but India mitigated impact; confident of pass-through and situation improving
items.quote: These are the geopolitical situations and the entire world is affected with this, not only India. India has mitigated the impact of it very effectively. We salute the dispensation. So yes, there is an impact and at the same time, we are very optimistic about the improvement in the situation. And this will not impact us much.

items.statement: Few listed pure-play fragrance/flavor peers in India; global majors dominate but Indian players gaining share; Sacheerome differentiated by innovation and cost-effectiveness

items.statement: New verticals (coal, fly ash, car carrier, freight forwarding) contributed 5.5% of FY26 revenue; target 10-12% in FY27 from mining, fly ash and coal
items.quote: for this year, we believe that fly ash transportation along with mining and coal will have a significant contribution of around 10-12% of my overall revenue.

items.statement: Top 10 customer concentration reduced to 73% in FY26 from 84% in FY24; over 90% revenue from large corporates

items.statement: Revenue per trip improved 9.3% in FY26 driven by better client route mix and premium verticals

items.statement: Completed 120,530 trips in FY26 vs 106,689 in FY25

items.statement: India 3PL market growing at 6-14% CAGR, expected to reach USD 48-70 billion by 2030; infrastructure programs accelerating freight movement

items.statement: Project logistics and ODC EBITDA margins are 25-30% versus 10-15% for general and contract logistics
items.quote: And if we see 15%, approximately 10% to 15% in general logistics and contract logistics, we can expect minimum 25% to 30% of EBITDA margins in the project logistics and over-dimensional cargo.

items.statement: Executed 38,200 orders in FY26 with average revenue per order of INR86,585; no spillover of unexecuted orders
items.quote: Operationally, we also continue to maintain strong execution levels during the year, handing over 24,733 vehicles and executing approximately 38,200 orders and our average revenue per order improved to INR86,585.

items.statement: ODC and project logistics revenue delayed due to port congestion; vehicles stuck at Mumbai port for 45 days awaiting unloading
items.quote: For ODC and project logistics, there was nothing which is delayed. Everything was moving, but the vehicles were not getting unloaded. So right now also, today is say, 2nd of June, and we still have vehicles which are standing in the Mumbai port for the past 45 days.

items.statement: Added 2 pullers and 38 axles in H2 FY26 for INR28 crores capex; total fleet now 11 pullers and 144 axles; expected INR4-5 crores annual revenue from new assets
items.quote: To support financial growth, we expanded our specialized fleet during H2 financial year 2026 through the addition of 2 pullers and 38 axles, taking our total to 11 and 144 axles.

items.statement: Incremental fleet assets expected to generate INR4-5 crores annual revenue with higher operating margins
items.quote: And in a year, we can expect approximately INR4 crores to INR5 crores of revenue with these assets, but the revenue is less, but obviously, the operating margin is higher in own fleet.

items.statement: Cost pass-through mechanisms now implemented; charging customers cost plus margin for third-party fleet
items.quote: See, right now, credit sales of diesel is still not happening. The availability is there, but the cost and the price has increased significantly, and we are charging that cost plus our margin to our customers now.

items.statement: Lag in implementing revised pricing in contract and general logistics due to multi-layer approval processes at MNC customers
items.quote: Further, there was a lag in implementing revised pricing structure and cost pass-through mechanisms in certain contracts like we had in contracted logistics, particularly in general logistics and contract logistics with the customers.

items.statement: FY26 revenue mix: Contract logistics 32%, ODC 35%, Project 20%, General logistics 13%; ODC and project share increasing
items.quote: From a segment perspective, contract logistics contributed 32% of the revenue during the financial year 2026. ODC contributed 35%, project contributed 20%, General logistic contributed 13%.

items.statement: Customer count reduced from 695 to 578 as part of quality-focused strategy; top 5 customers contribute ~20% of revenue
items.quote: As a part of our focus on quality-led growth, we continued strengthening our customer portfolio, while the number of customers stood at 578 compared to 695 in financial year '25.

items.statement: Top 5 customers contribute approximately 20% of total revenue; credit safety ensured through key account managers and credit control systems
items.quote: The revenue contribution of the top 5 customers would probably be -- just to give you a rough number, would be approximately 20%.

items.statement: Receivables flat at INR115 crores; debtor days improved from 140 to ~127 days; all receivables considered safe
items.quote: See, receivables, we had approximately INR115 crores in this financial year, and it was INR115 crores last financial year also. And the debtor we have -- I mean, the days -- the debtor days have also gone down from 140 days to 120 -- 127 approximate days.

items.statement: Debt to equity at 0.54x; operating cash flow positive at INR13.53 crores; no fundraise planned
items.quote: Our balance sheet remained healthy during the year. Debt to equity stood at 0.54x, while cash flow from operating activities remained positive at INR13.53 crores, reflecting disciplined working capital management and prudent financial practices.

items.statement: No fundraise planned; current capital sufficient for growth
items.quote: We are absolutely sufficient. There is no plans of any fundraise as of now.

items.statement: Transformer logistics contributes 5-10% of revenue; contract duration 6-8 months with visibility from Power Grid, UPPCL orders
items.quote: It should be approximately, say, 5% to 10% between that range.

items.quote: See, in wind and solar, there is huge orders that we already have. There are n number of contracts that we are currently executing for in the long-term basis. And to give you an exact number, we will definitely include that number in the next press release with the complete order status and how many orders we have in each sector-wise and how it is looking like.

items.statement: Industry disruptions from geopolitical developments, diesel shortage, credit sales stoppage, driver shortages, port congestion, RTO/VLTD compliance bottlenecks
items.quote: The transportation ecosystem witnessed several temporary industry-wide disruptions; arising from geopolitical developments, export trade challenges, supply side constraints, limited diesel availability, tighter credit, diesel sales, driver shortages, manpower shortages, reduced vehicle availability, elevated operating costs and port congestions.

items.statement: Defense logistics deprioritized due to coordination issues and high effort; removed from focus sectors
items.quote: See, defense, we started a year back, and we stopped also probably 6 months back, I think, and we've always removed from the investor PPT of the sectors that we serve as a defense. items.quote: I think the revenue right now that I see is approximately INR1 crore and the margins were -- it was -- the margins were decent also, and we have not put any sort of losses or any sort of cost -- any additional cost on this particular subsidiary. items.quote: We are now working towards a number; we are now working towards achieving 10,000 keys by the year 2030 and every decision we take is towards that direction.

items.quote: ARR was around INR3,850, up from INR3,620. And RevPAR came in at INR2,637. That's an 11.7% improvement year-on-year.

items.quote: Both are back online now, and this new improved product will help us to improve the ARR by 15% to 20% over the current ARRs from these hotels.

items.quote: Long weekends, festivals, and major sporting events like IPL have become key drivers of travel demand. Additionally, booking patterns have shifted considerably. items.statement: Plans to hire industry specialists for pharma, white goods, e-commerce to drive diversification.

items.statement: No material impact seen from current geopolitical scenario; order book and pipeline healthy.

items.statement: Trading business ~22% of revenue (steady at 20-25% run-rate); provides market intelligence and customer leads.
items.quote: Just a moment. Approximately 22%, sir.

items.statement: Current facility at peak utilisation (INR169 cr revenue); space and manpower constraints driving new facility.

items.statement: Approximately 40% of FY27 revenue target currently under bidding.

items.statement: H2 seasonally stronger (60% of revenue) with more repeat orders driving margin expansion.

items.statement: Acquired Spanish operations Conservas Selectas Espanolas S.L. and Gandin Invest S.L. (Sarasa brands) for entry into global specialty foods and olives market

items.statement: Indian standalone EBITDA margin 18.5%, PAT margin 11.55% in FY26; blended PAT margin target 10-11% for FY27
items.quote: The standalone number for the Indian unit is about 325 crores in revenue. The EBITDA was about 58 crores, EBITDA margin was about 18.5 crores, a PAT of about 36 crores, and we were able to achieve a PAT margin of about 11.55 crores.

items.statement: Spanish entity currently at 4-5% PAT margin, targeting 8-10% PAT and 12-14% EBITDA by substituting 30% production from India
items.quote: At the moment, they are at around 4-5 %. By substituting 30% of the production from India and achieving cost benefits by producing in India, we will We'll be able to substitute at least 30% of the products at a very, very high margin.

items.statement: New plant in Tamil Nadu started in 2025; combined capacity of two plants about 550 metric tons per day
items.quote: The new plant started last year, 2025, and was both the plants capable together about, you know, we can pass about 550 metric tons.

items.statement: Healthy order book with strong demand for gherkins and olives; gherkin exports exceeded 43,600 MT in FY26
items.quote: Our flagship Gherkins business continues to perform strongly with exports exceeding 43,600 metric tonnes during financial year 26 and contributing nearly 268 crores in revenue.

items.statement: Global gherkin market grew 40% over two years to 3,000+ crores; India gaining share as Germany/Turkey fail on price and delivery
items.quote: India's Gherkin market, the last two years has scaled about 40% of growth. When we, in the last year, we were having data of about 200,000 crores, but this year, sorry, 2,000 crores, this year the market has reached 3,000 crores.

items.statement: Strong demand for Spanish olives and Sarasa branded products; olives present in 90+ countries vs gherkins in 40+
items.quote: There's a great demand for olives, in fact S panish olives and branded olives of Sarasa. And we are looking forward to produce as much as possible in Spain and achieve a good sales revenue in the coming year

items.statement: EU-India FTA expected early 2027 to reduce duties from 7-14% to under 5%, boosting margins on retail packaging
items.quote: You would have heard of the EU treaty where the free trade agreement, which is expected to come up in the early 2027, which will reduce the duties of products exported from India. We are highly anticipating this trade agreement to be beneficial for us because it brings down the duties from 7 and 14% to, I think, less than 5%.

items.statement: Pre-emptive procurement of packaging materials (jars, plastic) in Q4 FY26 saved 15-20% ahead of supplier price hikes
items.quote: we tried to buy out everything which they had. It gave us about 15%-20% of savings on th e raw material, and that we are using it now because our contracts were closed in Jan, Feb

items.statement: Sarasa supplies 14,000+ retail outlets in Spain (Metro, Spar, Eroski); Freshara accesses 100+ customers in India across 40 countries
items.quote: As I mentioned, when we combine together, we will have a retail and a supermarket chain supply where Sarasa is already supplying to about 30 different companies and more than 14,000 retail outlets are having this brand present.

items.statement: Russia 35-40% market share, India's top exporter; Spain leading exporter with 60+ customers; US ~10% of business
items.quote: As you see, we are very strong in countries like Russia and Spain, where, in fact, in Russia, we almost hold about 35- 40% of the market share. In fact, India's market share to Russia is about 34 - 35%. So, we are one of the leading exporters for Russia.

items.statement: Cost advantage vs Global Green and Reitzel: 6-7% margin difference due to lean Indian operations vs European management overheads
items.quote: Our margins are much better because our cost control, and I mean our costs are any day better than them, because they have a European management in India and they have very high cost output. We, on the other hand, have a very lean cost output, so I mean you can easily say we have a 6-7% difference of margin between us and them.

items.statement: Seasonal inventory peak in Q4 (Jan-Mar crop arrival) doubles inventory; pre-emptive packaging material buildup for 4-5 month cover
items.quote: Basically, the Q4 is when all the 4000 plus farmers contribute to us. I mean, the Tamil Nadu Circle, the Karnataka and the Andra, all three have crops at the same time. So, in the last year, what has happened is our yields have kind of doubled.

items.statement: Appointed seasoned Spanish management, retained best talent, weekly reviews; Junaid directly oversees export strategy and global sourcing
items.quote: We have appointed a very seasoned management. We have recruited quality specialists. We have retained the best people and we have let go the people whom we didn't want to retain. So, we have an option of doing this, which is which was very, very unique.

items.statement: Logistics routing via Cape of Good Hope and Red Sea; limited Middle East exposure; Strait of Hormuz disruption affects only minor routes
items.quote: See, war brings challenges. Some roads are affected, your Strait of Hormuz is affected, but you know, business always finds it its way. You know, we are now transiting through Red Sea because previously Red Sea was blocked. Today Hormuz is blocked. Red Sea is functional.

items.statement: EU-India FTA expected early 2027 to cut duties from 7-14% to under 5%, especially benefiting retail packaging (currently 14% duty)
items.quote: Today, when we produce Gherkins in India and when we supply to Sarasa, they have to pay duties close to 4 and 7%. So, this will bring down the cost to a great extent. The industrial packaging suffers the lowest duty and the retail packaging suffers the highest duty, that's about 14%.

items.statement: Exports to 40+ countries; olives in 90+ countries; combined platform targets global presence; Europe entry via Spanish entity bypasses preference for local suppliers
items.quote: As gherkins, we try to service 40 plus countries, but as olives, they are already present. Olives are already pres ent in 90 plus countries. So, you know, it helps combine olives and gherkins and, gives us a great space to go to more countries

items.statement: B2B (India) and B2C (Spain) revenue mix expected to equalize in 2-3 years as olives sell at 3x gherkin price per unit volume
items.quote: It will eventually equal up because scaling up olives is going to be much faster. At doing one-third of my volume, they can reach my turnover, actually, because the cost of olives and selling price of olives is almost 3x the times of Gherkins.

items.statement: Management expects Spanish margins to reach 8-10% from current 4-5%
items.quote: We expect to. Shubham Gupta: Okay. Junaid Ahmed: Reach about 8 to 10%, and try to, you know, improve it from there

items.quote: There is no 150 plus Capex addition. Geetarth Tandon: Okay. Junaid Ahmed: It is, the slide states that if we had done the Spanish entity all by ourselves, it would have costed 150 crores. Geetarth Tandon: OKOK. Junaid Ahmed: So, there are no

items.quote: This year they will be at 50-60%, and they should be able to do the 200 crore mark easily, and then next year is when the, when we'll be trying to stretch them to reach 75 -80%; that's where we want them to operate somewhere close to 350 -400 crores.

items.statement: Indian margins at 11-12%; Spanish margins currently 4-5% due to only two months of operations
items.quote: No, at the moment, the Indian margins are around 11, 12%, but Spanish margins are close to, that is about 4-5% because you just had two months of business.

items.statement: El Nino not a major risk; yields doubled to 8-10 tons/acre; customer understands climate and pays better
items.quote: The yields have doubled compared to the last El Nino years, when the average yields were 3-4 tons per acre. Today they are 8 to 10 tons per acre. So, I don't think climate plays a very major role for us.

items.quote: A part of it, you know 25% of the acquisition was funded with internal accruals. We've gone ahead with warrant , we generate d about 9 1/2 crores from the warrant. Remaining was bank funded for the stock, where we got a 29-30 crore limit to buy the stocks.

items.statement: Plans to raise working capital in Spain using Sarasa's profitable balance sheet and banking track record
items.quote: we should be able to use the banks in Spain because they have had a very good track record in the past and the profitable balance sheet, we should be able to raise working capital, secured or unsecured working ca pital in Spain

items.statement: Focus on stable-margin products; avoiding olive oil commodities; adding value-added like cocktail olives and ready-to-cook vegetables
items.quote: Olive oil. Olive oil, see oil goes into commodities. We generally don't want to deal with products which have fluctuating margins. We are currently dealing with products with very stable margins and we want to position ourselves as a fine foods exporter or importer.

items.statement: Cross-selling strategy: introducing Sarasa to Freshara's top 5 global customers; sampling and pricing discussions underway
items.quote: We are trying to bring in our large customers who are already buying from Spain, from a different company , the top five, again. These companies would, are very happy with us, so we are inviting them to the Spanish plant.

items.statement: Sarasa acquisition opens 120+ countries via olive network; gherkins can piggyback on olive distribution

items.statement: Conservative 1000 crore aspiration by FY30; next year's guidance to be given next year
items.quote: See, it's good to be conservative and come out with numbers which are better than what they are on the screen, right? So, yeah, this is what I don't want to speculate too far. At the same time, I would also want to show you an aspiration of what the company is looking forward to.

items.statement: Indian unit capable of 500 crore revenue; intrinsic expansion planned without major capex
items.quote: The unit itself is capable of doing close to 500 crores, so we don't really require a large Capex or anything, but yes, as we bring in premium customers, the requirements of Capex are there, here and there, so we try to add it on to accommodate customers.

items.statement: Fertiliser cost <10% of crop input; using drip, mulching, sustainable methods to improve yields and reduce water dependence
items.quote: See, the cost of fertilizer, I mean, on the whole crop, the cost of input of fertilizer, I don't think is more than 10%. There are other chemicals fertilized, other materials which are also used for growing the crop, like staking materials and mulching sheets.

items.statement: Geopolitical wars cause psychological impact on numbers; maintains high stock to ensure supply continuity

items.quote: We didn't buy the company, we just bought the assets, right? So, it's a, it's a zero, it's a zero start, but it comes with an advantage of a brand and a large olive market.

items.quote: We intend to begin by having a technology tie-up with certain international companies, getting SKD (semi-knocked-down) solutions, doing assembly here, and starting to provide solutions to our customers.

items.quote: When we started, our imports used to be around 75-80% of our total purchases. Now, our imports are around 50%, and we are actively working to get it down to around 30% in the next 2 years.

items.quote: There have also been discussions of some inorganic growth — we have spoken to two companies where we see synergies could form and where we could take a majority stake, adding inorganic growth.

items.statement: R&D team of 3-4 senior engineers (Rs 8-30 lakh packages) plus juniors and interns
items.quote: We have decently qualified engineers whose packages range anywhere between M8 lakhs per annum to up to B30 lakhs per annum — a team of 3—4 people in this range, plus junior executives and interns.

items.quote: It is pipe only. In our case, it is pipes, valves, and pumping machinery for water supply and irrigation sector.

items.quote: In as per the price increase in mild steel, ductile iron, and HDPE pipe, PVC pipe, all these pipes will be there, major item. For those, as per the RBI indices, there will be a calculation for price variation. Based on that, we will get the price variation amount from the government.

items.statement: Bid-to-win ratio around 25%
items.quote: We are having around 25%.

items.statement: Bidding at own price is the main challenge in competitive market
items.quote: Bidding the projects, bidding and getting the project at our price. In this competitive field, bidding at our - getting our project at our price.

items.statement: No pending payments from government authorities after project completion
items.quote: No, it's nothing like that.

items.statement: ROW issues cause time delays in scattered village projects; factored into tender quotes
items.quote: In general, government projects, that too water sector, these projects are in a scattered locations. In that, due to ROW issues, there are time delays. We will consider all those things and we will quote the tender.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth target 30-50% aiming for Rs 300 cr at upper end
items.quote: For the full-year FY27, our business target is 30% to 50% of revenue growth, top line and bottom line, aiming to hit 300 crores of revenue at the upper end.

items.statement: EBITDA margin compressed from 8.5% to 6.8% due to higher freight costs and working capital pilot
items.quote: On margins, our EBITDA margin moved from 8.5% to 6.8%. Now, this is basically because underlying numbers are actually positive, because our core trading margin, which is our gross profitfrom operations, before costof services, it actually increased from 19.4%to 22.4

items.statement: ERIS platform visibility covers ~1 million tons inventory worth $300M annually, 20% of Indian import market
items.quote: Today, ERIS has visibility of nearly 1 million tons of inventory in the system, worth around $300 million annually. And that is 20% of the Indian import market.

items.statement: Converting 10-12% of visible inventory opportunity into actual business
items.quote: And we are currently converting around 10% to 12% of this visible opportunity into actual business.

items.statement: Target to scale container volumes from 6,000 to 10,000 annually
items.quote: We are currently moving around 6,000 containers annually, supported by more than 25 global logistic partners. And our aim is to scale to 10,000 containers this year.

items.statement: Freight costs elevated due to higher oil prices and shift to UK/Europe sourcing with higher logistic intensity
items.quote: main driver of this was a deliberate shift of our sourcing mix towards UK and European markets that carry a higher logistic intensity and cost. items.quote: And this segment grew from about Rs. 3.9 crores to roughly Rs. 4.4 crores, which is a 13% increase. The core point is that this services segment operates ata much higher margin versus the product segment

items.quote: Our debtor days on a closing basis were mostly flat, went from 99 to 103 days. And on an average basis, between FY25-26, went from 75 to 80, so not much movement over there. items.statement: Invoice financing program starting at Rs 2.5 cr scaling to Rs 15 cr to accelerate receivables conversion
items.quote: The agreement is to start with an initial limit of Rs. 2.5 crores, and the target is to scale this to Rs. 15 crores throughout the year as we grow our receivables book, basically to let us turn our receivables faster into cash, so we can fund our growth without the balance sheet expanding one for one.

items.statement: No further external capital needed for working capital until approaching Rs 500 cr revenue

items.statement: Expanding beyond India to serve European and African mills; high-seas sales model provides natural FX hedge
items.quote: With better inventory visibility and logistic intelligence, we have also started expanding beyond India. We are now able to serve European and African mills as well, which is helping EXIM Routes build a stronger global footprint.

items.statement: Monthly supply volumes doubled from 6,000-8,000 tons in April 2025 to ~12,000-16,000 tons by March 2026

items.statement: Operating cost ratio improved from 3.8% to 3.1% of revenue; employee cost from 1.7% to 1.4% due to ERIS automation

items.statement: Competitive advantage from proprietary multi-country product data, logistics intelligence, and execution capability that pure marketplaces lack
items.quote: So, what happened that, okay, then we started the business and we started to quantify the data. Because we are paper engineers, so we knew that what technical aspects they need. items.quote: And that is where the system that we have built around ERIS s a differentiator because itis not a plain vanilla, here is a digital open marketplace. It actually brings all those things together and really solves the problems for both parties

items.statement: Business structurally second-half weighted; H1 FY26 generated only 30-35% of full-year EBITDA
items.quote: The business that we are in is structurally seasonal. So, historically what you have seen and what you will see is that the businessis structurally second-half weighted. So, if I look at FY26 as an example, H1 generated about 30% to 35% of full-year EBITDA, and the second half was two weeks of H1

items.statement: Targets double-digit operating margin in FY27
items.quote: no we are I'm precisely aiming this year for double digit I will try to achieve that

items.quote: We invested almost about 10 crores in this polymer division itself

items.quote: Sir, that was a news item, but as on date we have not received anything from NSE or SEBI regarding that. So, from that itself, it is clear that it was a rumor.

items.quote: Shareholders' approval for deviation in utilisation of IPO proceeds is to be obtained.

items.statement: Expect EBITDA margin improvement in FY27 but no precise projection given
items.quote: Margins are on track and we expect improvement. We cannot give a precise forward projection, but margins will increase.

items.statement: Order book over Rs 700 crore as of H1 FY27, executable over next one year
items.quote: As of the first half of FY27, our order book stood at over 700 crores, executable over the next one year — among the strongest value visibility positions in our history.

items.statement: Epitome Industries contract worth Rs 957 crore is largest ever single contract
items.quote: The Epitome Industries contract at 957 crores — our largest ever single contract, representing a major step up in project scale and complexity.

items.statement: ONGC Nandej production enhancement contract marks strategic entry into crude oil services
items.quote: The ONGC Nandej production enhancement contract — a landmark contract for RBM, marking our strategic entry into crude oil services and the upstream value chain.

items.statement: Bid pipeline of close to Rs 3,354 crore across refineries, ports, power, green energy, mines and 7-8 segments
items.quote: Our bid pipeline stands at close to 3,354 crores across different stages — refineries, ports, power plants, green energy, mines, and about 7-8 segments in total.

items.statement: Gross block of PPE grew from Rs 24 crore to Rs 113.11 crore in FY26, addition of almost Rs 2,100 crore in plant, machinery and equipment
items.quote: Our gross block of property, plant and equipment has grown from %24 crores to ¥113.11 crores — an addition of almost 2100 crores in plant, machinery and equipment in a single year

items.statement: Initial investment of Rs 600 million into land and basic infrastructure for semiconductor project, additional investment in 2-3 years
items.quote: We will initially invest 600 million into land and basic infrastructure. Additional investment will follow in 2-3 years.

items.statement: ONGC field production increased from 450 to 800 barrels per day in one year
items.quote: When | took over the field one year ago, we were producing 450 barrels. Today we are producing 800 barrels

items.quote: We plan to drill 5 wells and have completed the workover per ONGC guidelines. We have kept our rig and may bring our own rig in 5-6 months.

items.quote: Steel costs have increased by ¥5-6 per kg and we purchased inventory to lock in rates before further price increases

items.quote: This is the result of a deliberate strategy built across our six verticals: EPC, O&M, plant turnarounds, crude oil services, and annual rate contracts (ARCs), along with projects we are executing with various clients.

items.quote: Our ongoing ARCs with Nayara, Yara Fertilizers, RIL, and multiple other clients form a strong recurring revenue base.

items.statement: Competition high for Rs 100-300 crore projects, decreases significantly above Rs 500 crore

items.quote: You can expect the mainboard migration in approximately 20-25 days.

items.quote: The Epitome project is ongoing — 50-60% of the work is underway. For machinery alone, 45 crores of advance was required; without it we could not procure and deliver the equipment.

items.quote: We will clear it in June. It is taking time for the third party to provide certification. It will be completed within the June quarter.

items.quote: Our total loans stand at 3111 crores as of date. Advances relate primarily to machinery advances and raw material purchases.

items.statement: No equity dilution planned in next 6-8 months, focus on debt repayment first

items.quote: For incremental production, ONGC retains 34% and RBM retains 66%.

items.quote: PAT margin should be around 5% to 7%. And EBITDA -- again, consolidated EBITDA should be somewhere around 20% to 25%.

items.quote: Cash flow from operations has improved from almost break-even in financial year '25 to over INR52 crores in this financial year.

items.quote: Dividend of course yes, but I can't promise you next year, but yes in next couple of years, 2 to 3 years, we would like to go for it because we are on a expansion spree.

items.quote: Manufacturing facilities are multiproduct and flexible, allowing capacity redeployment across liquids and other growth categories. The company does not expect material stranded manufacturing exposure arising solely from this transition.

items.quote: As far as distribution muscle is concerned and our relationship with distribution, which is not dependent on one particular brand, which is Pril. So, we have a plethora of brands, and our go-to-market strategy is built on the whole basket.
